about: Counts for the floods series, d1 (rough draft): from `isoscape info` on regions/richmond-floods-d1.json. Buildings are those the dated view shows (standing today by year built, plus traced and curated), not every building of the year. Acres are off the river’s own channel, inside the frame. Depths at buildings are the deepest point of each footprint, true feet. Levels are feet NAVD88 at the City Locks (levels.json).

plates.basis: Corps figure 38 ft on the old Weather Bureau scale near Mayo's Bridge (from diaries) + 2.36 - 1.03 = 39.3 at Mayo; minus 1.3 to the Locks. Rests on diary accounts and on the 1876 gauge scale; UNCONFIRMED as an elevation
PP 924 gives 27.5 ft msl at the City Locks; HA-410 marks near the Locks read 27.2 to 27.5 NGVD29; minus 1.03
City Locks 28.64 ft NGVD29 at 6 a.m. Aug 22 (OFR 70-51) minus 1.03; HA-410 marks agree
City Locks gauge 36.5 ft on its 1957 NGVD29 zero minus 1.03, and the Dock and Pear sign 35.5 NAVD88 agree; add about 1.3 ft by the Mayo Bridge
NWS City Locks crest 30.76 ft, gauge era 1957-2007 (NGVD29 zero) minus 1.03; other accounts round to 30.7-31
NWS City Locks crest 23.75 ft; taken as the NGVD29-zero era (USGS NAVD88 series starts Oct 1 2007); if the 1996 value were already NAVD88 the level is 23.75, so the error is one-sided upward
USGS approved NAVD88 series at City Locks peaks at 16.96 ft at 04:48-04:54 EST Nov 14 2020
City Locks gauge 36.5 ft on its 1957 NGVD29 zero minus 1.03, and the Dock and Pear sign 35.5 NAVD88 agree; add about 1.3 ft by the Mayo Bridge
Gaston: a judgment from reported depths (gaston-water.md), not a surveyed level

period_city.about: d2, the period city from evidence (tools/floods/period/, history/richmond-floods.json): buildings shown on each plate before and after, confirmed and unconfirmed apart. "Shown" counts today's buildings and traced ones the scene draws (inside the frame, not on water or track); "gained confirmed" is confirmed after less everything shown before (the old "assumed" traced buildings counted as shown before). Coverage: buildings by evidence class and area (tools/floods/coverage.ts). Choices: what each bound draws over the whole evidence file, before the scene's own leave-outs.

d3.about: Working draft d3 (tools/floods/d3/boxcounts.ts): for every plate of the two sets, the whole plate and each box. `plate`: acres under water off the channel; buildings shown and in water (any corner or the center under the surface; traced buildings included), confirmed and unconfirmed apart; outbuildings left out (far from the water). Boxes: depth at the center (2 m lidar against the flood's surface there), acres under water inside the box, buildings shown and in water. Manchester is today's city; its with- and without-wall plates are both listed.

boxes.about: Floods series d3: the close-up boxes of the two sets. `at` is the box's center (lon, lat); each area's boxes are `size` SVG units (Shockoe 340 by 165, 170 m across at the plate's scale of 2; Manchester 320 by 320), shaped to the sheet's cells. Shockoe boxes are drawn for Agnes 1972 beside its dry twin; Manchester boxes for the 1972 height against today's wall beside the same without the wall. Notes are one line each, from the series' research (drafts/richmond-floods/casestudy/2026-11-23-02-research-river-floods-and-the-wall/) and the floods log.

boxes.title: 17th Street Market
boxes.note: The lowest blocks of the Bottom, where the water stands in nearly every flood.

boxes.title: Main Street Station and its train shed
boxes.note: The station of 1901 and its long shed, standing in the water.

boxes.title: 17th and Dock, the canal's end
boxes.note: Where the Bottom meets the river; the wall's Dock Street opening today.

boxes.title: Shockoe Slip, 14th and Cary
boxes.note: The water's edge at the foot of downtown.

boxes.title: Mayo Island
boxes.note: The island under the river, its buildings in it.

boxes.title: 18th and Cary, Tobacco Row's west end
boxes.note: Warehouses between Cary and Dock streets, wet in every flood here.

boxes.title: East Franklin and Grace, 17th to 19th
boxes.note: Rows of shops and houses from 1842 to 1913, most of them still standing.

boxes.title: Hull Street at the Mayo Bridge
boxes.note: The bridge foot, inside the wall: dry with it, deep without.

boxes.title: The flats at 5th and Stockton
boxes.note: Warehouses and shops on the old floodplain the wall now guards.

boxes.title: The tank farm
boxes.note: Storage tanks on the flats, behind the wall.

boxes.title: On the wall
boxes.note: The south wall west of the Mayo Bridge: water on the river side, dry ground behind.

boxes.title: The treatment plant grounds
boxes.note: The earthen levee is not mapped; the lidar's ridge along I-95 may be it; whether the plant is inside it is not in our data.

occlusion.about: tools/floods/d3/occlusion.ts on every d3 plate and twin, before (d3, STRICT=0) and after occlusion "strict" (d3 round two, 2026-11-25): pairs painted over a nearer item ("order"), wall joints, pairs whose footprints overlap on the ground ("overlap", the data), and sloped decks against each other ("decks").

rc1.about: Final draft rc1 (1.0.0-rc1). `plates`: each plate's caption counts from its build (scene stats): `floodShown` is every building the plate draws, traced ones included, and `floodShownInWater` those standing in the water (d3 captions counted today's buildings only: `buildings`, `floodBuildingsInWater`); `tracedCovered` the traced footprints left out under a building of the year (rule: half or more covered, regions' `tracedCovered: 0.5`). `boxes`: tools/floods/d3/boxcounts.ts on each plate (whole plate and each box of tools/floods/d3/boxes.json, rc1 boxes). `fromD3`: the whole-plate count of buildings shown and in water, d3 against rc1, as boxcounts counts them (traced included in both).

rc2.about: Final draft rc2 (1.0.0-rc2). `plates`: each plate's caption counts from its build (scene stats): `floodShown` is every building the plate draws, traced ones included, and `floodShownInWater` those standing in the water (d3 captions counted today's buildings only: `buildings`, `floodBuildingsInWater`); `tracedCovered` the traced footprints left out under a building of the year (rule: half or more covered, regions' `tracedCovered: 0.5`). `boxes`: tools/floods/d3/boxcounts.ts on each plate (whole plate and each box of tools/floods/d3/boxes.json, rc1 boxes). `fromD3`: the whole-plate count of buildings shown and in water, rc1 against rc2, as boxcounts counts them (traced included in both). rc2: land whose protection is not known (`floodUnknownAcres`, `floodUnknownBuildings`) is left out of the with-wall plates' acres and buildings in the water and counted apart; Gaston drawn at 28 ft solid to 35 ft hatched.

rc3.about: Final draft rc3 (1.0.0-rc3). `plates`: each plate's caption counts from its build (scene stats): `floodShown` is every building the plate draws, traced ones included, and `floodShownInWater` those standing in the water (d3 captions counted today's buildings only: `buildings`, `floodBuildingsInWater`); `tracedCovered` the traced footprints left out under a building of the year (rule: half or more covered, regions' `tracedCovered: 0.5`). `boxes`: tools/floods/d3/boxcounts.ts on each plate (whole plate and each box of tools/floods/d3/boxes.json, rc1 boxes). `fromD3`: the whole-plate count of buildings shown and in water, rc2 against rc3, as boxcounts counts them (traced included in both). rc2: land whose protection is not known (`floodUnknownAcres`, `floodUnknownBuildings`) is left out of the with-wall plates' acres and buildings in the water and counted apart; Gaston drawn at 28 ft solid to 35 ft hatched. rc3: Gaston's pool held on the city side of the wall (`citySide`).
